messages:
ana: deploybot blocked the rollout — keystore secret key mismatch between staging and prod.

deploybot: Release 6211 blocked: keystore.path.secret mismatch.
Staging: `keystore.secret-sentinel`
Prod:    `keystore.secretSentinel`
Issue: canonicalization (dash vs camelCase).

morgan: ack. scope?

chris: inference-cache service only; staging missed a migration that normalized keys.

sre-oncall: hold the rollout. don't touch prod during change window.

ana: plan: 1) backfill staging keystore with prod alias (`secretSentinel`) 2) rerun preflight 3) promote or rollback to pinned image.

morgan: ETA for backfill?

chris: script runs ~2m in staging. will schedule during short maintenance window.

ops-bot: job scheduled: staging-keystore-backfill at 2026-03-20T22:10:00Z

ana: pin rollback image: `infra/inference:2026-03-18-rc3`, opening hotfix INF-2147.

deploybot: note: blocked >30m will page oncall.

platform-team: scanning for other keystore naming anomalies.

ops-bot: backfill job SUCCESS — alias `secretSentinel` added in staging.

deploybot: re-running preflight for Release 6211...

deploybot: Preflight PASSED.

ana: promoting now, monitoring 15m. rollback plan ready.

sre-oncall: watching dashboards.

morgan: staging looks clean.

ana: promoted :tada:

chris: will add canonicalization check to deploycheck as follow-up (see INF-2147).

ana: closing after 15m with no incidents.
